name: Zoe
description: A service design concept connecting consumers with local tailors for custom, sustainable clothing.

text: Zoe is a fashion design concept that reimagines the relationship between consumers and clothing by connecting them directly with local tailors. The platform allows users to choose their desired fit, select patterns and materials, and have garments custom-made. It offers them an alternative to fast fashion's mass-produced model.

The project began with extensive stakeholder mapping across the fashion ecosystem, identifying core, direct, and indirect actors, from local communities and tailors to fast fashion brands and government policy makers.

sections.alt: Stakeholder ecosystem map and influence-interest matrix for the fashion industry
Paper prototypes of the app spread across a design workspace

text: The design process relied heavily on paper prototyping and rapid iteration. Physical phone mockups were crafted to simulate the app experience, allowing users to interact with tangible screens showing clothing customization flows, pattern selection, and tailor profiles.

Key features include sustainability tracking with carbon footprint visibility, material sourcing transparency, the ability to schedule live sessions with tailors, and progressive disclosure of the story behind each garment and its maker.
